title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the protocol.ts preamble into 22 themed modules, verbatim (#25467 E0)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UmbUGPtw5rdRcd3UpYXs5N)_

Part of #25467

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：把 `protocol.ts` 类定义之上的整段前言（183 条顶层声明，约 6,300 行）原样搬进 22 个按主题命名的 `protocol-*.ts` 模块；`protocol.ts` 照旧导出原来导出的每个名字。没有任何逻辑改动。
- **为什么改**：`protocol.ts` 是 server 车道的热文件，每个改它的 PR 都要排队；这是 #25467 裁决 E 的第一步 E0（E1、E2 之后另派），按字母 A 的 `.d.ts` 新判据落地。
- **风险与回滚**：低。工具逐条证明 190/190 条语句逐字搬移、无改动无多余；对外 `index.d.ts` 声明集合、顺序、ESM/CJS 导出名单都不变，原始字节只差空行、一条 import 内的名字顺序、一个字面量联合的成员顺序。另把 QA 清单和 spec liveness 账本里 3 处指向被搬符号的引用改指新模块。回滚即整体 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（文件头的 import/export 名单）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`（迁移后的按路径 pin）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件全绿（main 上的搬移前形态同样绿；搬移后不迁移则红 2 条）。
- **需要你做的**：审批合并（改动约 13,200 行，超过 3,000 行人工合并线）；另请确认 `packages/spec/liveness/query.json` 两处证据引用改指新模块可以留在本 PR（不留则 `check:liveness` 红）。

## What changes

Step **E0** of ruling E (6537939895, folded onto #25467 in 6537947529), landed under letter A (6545252863). Move-only.

- Every top-level statement above `export class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` that is not an import or an export list (183 declarations) moves **verbatim, with its leading comments**, into one of 22 new themed modules: `protocol-meta-type-schema`, `protocol-authoring-refusals`, `protocol-metadata-issues`, `protocol-publish-backfill-request`, `protocol-data-request-shapes`, `protocol-view-normalization`, `protocol-package-bindings`, `protocol-bundle-members`, `protocol-overlay-merge`, `protocol-version-tokens`, `protocol-write-constants`, `protocol-client-failures`, `protocol-list-query-params`, `protocol-discovery-services`, `protocol-reference-hits`, `protocol-write-face`, `protocol-package-lifecycle-types`, `protocol-mutation-events`, `protocol-authoring-channel`, `protocol-audit-entry`, `protocol-stored-overlay-types`, `protocol-door-requests`.
- The theming is the predecessor trial's (`claude/project-thread-6aibsn@4a35157e`, seat 4's report 6542958324), redone by tool on fresh `main`. The three statements added since that trial follow the statement before them: `isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage` → `protocol-authoring-refusals`, `perPackageLayerEnvelope` → `protocol-package-bindings`, `storedEntryRow` → `protocol-stored-overlay-types`.
- The only new text is import lists, export lists (`export { … }` at a module's foot for a name that was module-private and is now shared; `export { … } from` in `protocol.ts` for every name it exported before) and a module header comment per module. The three preamble export lists that re-export imports (`FormFieldInput`, `recordNotFoundError`, `stripReadDecorations`) stay in `protocol.ts` with their comments. `protocol.ts` imports the modules in the order that keeps the rolled-up `.d.ts` declaration order equal to the base's.
- `protocol.ts`: 30,912 → 24,892 lines (on `main` `f125ce40da`). No class-body member is touched (that is E1/E2).
- Three citations that named a moved symbol at `protocol.ts` and no longer resolve there are re-pointed at the module it moved to: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` (`diffShallow` → `protocol-write-face.ts`, twice; `protectionBlockRefusal` → `protocol-authoring-refusals.ts`) and `packages/spec/liveness/query.json` (`QUERY_AST_KEYS`, `WIRE_DOLLAR_ALIASES` → `protocol-list-query-params.ts`; red in `check:platform-checklist --changed-from` and `check:liveness` before). Citations that still resolve through `protocol.ts`'s re-exports (`ConcurrentUpdateError`, `servedViewExpansion`, `specValidationFindings`, and the ADR texts) are left as they are; `check:adr-symbol-anchors` is green.
- Changeset `.changeset/25467-e0-protocol-preamble-modules.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, and `patch` on `@objectstack/spec` because `liveness/` ships in its tarball; both declaration lines.

## Tests

Forced edits, all because a reader names a moved symbol by its file path: two tests and two data files that are not tests.

Two by-path pins read preamble symbols out of `protocol.ts` and are migrated in this PR (forced test edits, both in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`):

- **`protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`**: `envelopePackageId`'s one definition is read from `protocol-package-bindings.ts`; two assertions are added so the pin keeps its reach: `protocol.ts` defines no copy of its own, and it imports `envelopePackageId` from that module.
- **`protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`**: the four door request aliases (`SaveMetaItemRequest` … `DeleteMetaItemRequest`) are read from `protocol-door-requests.ts`, only when `protocol.ts` imports them from that module, so the signature judged is still the one the class names.

Two by-path citations in data files are re-pointed (forced, not tests): `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` and `packages/spec/liveness/query.json`, as listed under What changes.

Before the migration the package suite was 2 failed / 298 passed files, the failures exactly these two pins (13 of 17 verbs found; `function envelopePackageId` not in `protocol.ts`).

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, each from committed HEAD through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- **read-verb fold:** `saveMetaItemUnaudited`'s `request = canonicalizeMetaRequestType(request);` replaced by `request = { ...request };` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `a0a204da0761` → `6d869851bc31`). The pin goes red: `Tests 1 failed | 17 passed (18)`, received `[ "saveMetaItem" ]` against `[]`, the verb whose request type now comes from the moved alias.
- **lookup, definition home:** the bindings module's `envelopePackageId` signature changed (`served: unknown` → `served?: unknown`; blob `e062a10a8f3e` → `47d2d431def2`). Red: `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, `expected '// Copyright …' to match /\nfunction envelopePackageId\(request…/`.
- **lookup, no second copy:** a local `function envelopePackageId(…)` put back into `protocol.ts` (blob `a0a204da0761` → `cb2f4764a1cf`). Red: `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, `expected '// Copyright …' not to match /\nfunction envelopePackageId\(/`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Move-only, by tool** (a verifier separate from the move tool): every non-import top-level statement of base `protocol.ts` (190, the class and the three trailer statements included), leading comments included and blank lines before it excluded, appears verbatim exactly once across head `protocol.ts` and the 22 modules: verbatim 190, missing 0, changed 0, surplus 0, duplicated 0. Head adds import statements (109 → 183), 47 export lists and 165 module-header comment lines. **Negative control:** one operator changed in `protocol-version-tokens.ts` (`hash = hash & hash` → `hash = hash | hash`) → verbatim 189, changed 1, surplus 1 (`simpleHash`), exit 1; restored, blob equals HEAD.
- **`.d.ts`, normaliser 2 (letter A).** Read-only, not a gate (the card adds no gate). Normalised: drop blank lines; sort the names inside each import brace list; sort each run of consecutive string/number literal members of a union. Everything else survives.

  | `dist/index.d.ts` (= `index.d.cts` byte for byte, both sides) | base `main` `f125ce40da` | head `20d8c2c813` |
  |---|---|---|
  | raw sha256 | `65a4356b2efed1dd5d25e5d80a55fccfef2adfd4a6c098c686d85f1a4749b0ab` | `d939f04a7ae66bbf19398a1f7ff4d905748fe9de667b8092105cffae3deec955` |
  | normaliser 2 sha256 | `7dea44d6d7660b9c7412af3cd0c6aa0382e3ab11dc52505431372f8185ecd97d` | `7dea44d6d7660b9c7412af3cd0c6aa0382e3ab11dc52505431372f8185ecd97d` |

  An earlier reading, base `74a19dd857` against head `c1d3b9dec3`, gave equal normaliser 2 hashes the same way (`ff357c33…`).

  Raw diff: 11 added blank lines, 1 line pair (the `@objectstack/spec/api` import brace list, `MetadataAuthoringSurface, MetadataAuthoringClient` first) and 2 line pairs (`columns?:` in `getMetaTypes()`'s inferred return type, members permuted). Declaration sequence (182 top-level statements) identical but for that import line; the final export-list line identical.

  **Positive controls** (each applied to head, each must differ from base and does): a class's `private engine;` made public; one name dropped from the export list; `MetadataWriteFace` moved to the end; one union literal dropped; one `readonly` removed; and a real one, an earlier layout of this head whose `.d.ts` carried a leaked JSDoc comment (below). **Negative controls** (each allowed kind alone, applied to base, must equal base and does): blank lines inserted; the import brace list reversed; the literal union permuted. The controls assert each edit landed (raw text changed).
- **A declaration-emit trap met on the way, noted (not filed: it changes no published meaning and is TypeScript's behaviour, not this package's).** The first layout of this move published `description? /** [#27842] The list's disabledActions … */: string | undefined;` inside `getMetaTypes()`'s inferred return type: the emitter printed a comment that sits in `protocol.ts` at the byte offset of a node reused from another file. One line more in the `protocol.ts` header comment moved the offset and the comment left the `.d.ts`. It struck again after merging `main` with #29093 (class-body lines shifted); two more lines in the E0 note (now 5 lines, which also tells the next editor to read the raw `.d.ts` diff) cleared it, and the final reading above has no comment in the raw diff. Normaliser 2 does not tolerate it (positive control P6). Any edit of `protocol.ts` on `main` can trip it the same way while `getMetaTypes()` has an inferred return type; E1/E2 will meet it again and should read their raw diffs for it.
- **In flight on the same files, re-read just before opening** (`origin/main` `5780fa49df`; 30 commits past this branch's last merge, none touching `protocol.ts` or any file of this PR, `git merge-tree` clean, so not merged again). #29093 (#28990) has merged and is in this branch. Open PRs that touch `protocol.ts`, each against this head by `git merge-tree`:
  - #28731 (draft, head `8372e0a1`): hunks at base line 3330 (`ConcurrentUpdateError`'s doc comment, which this PR moves to `protocol-version-tokens.ts`) and in the class body. **Conflicts**: whichever lands second carries that doc-comment edit to the other side.
  - #29270 (draft), #29307: add names to `protocol.ts`'s own import lists, which stay in `protocol.ts`, plus class-body hunks. Clean.
  - #29290, #29295: class-body hunks only. Clean.
  - #29317 touches `studio-authoring.json` in another item (revision 11 of the object designer item). Clean.
  Any of them landing shifts `protocol.ts` offsets, so the comment leak above can come back on its own; it is not this PR's to guard.
- E0 is one step of a series; `Part of #25467` keeps the card open for E1 and E2.

The two commits after it change the changeset and two comment lines in `protocol.ts`; the published `.d.ts` normaliser 2 hash is the same.
